_doc: Reusable COUNTRY registry for the multi-country field guide. The root index.html is a COUNTRY HUB (default view: the US city list) with a switcher to each live country's own hub. Two kinds of country: kind 'us' = the US cities built by the dataset/engine city builds (cleveland.html + cities/*.html), listed by hand in index.html; kind 'engine' = the pastel one-page-per-place guides cloned from the Cleveland engine by tools/build-singapore-pages.py (Singapore towns, Vietnam cities, and future SEA countries). Each engine country's `region` MUST match the region string used in build-singapore-pages PLACES. `folder` is where that country's place pages + its own hub (index.html) are written; today only Vietnam has its own folder — Singapore and the not-yet-live SEA countries share the Singapore/ folder (so the archived all-SEA hub Singapore/singapore-old.html keeps resolving). Set live:true and add the country's card to index.html when it is ready to surface. 'We populate US, Singapore and Vietnam first'; the rest stay live:false, reachable only from the archived Singapore/singapore-old.html, until each is populated through the full pipeline (sources -> fact-check -> re-rank -> location-verify). See docs/COUNTRIES.md.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.blurb: The city-state, town by town — hawker food and landmarks, opening on Toa Payoh.

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.blurb: Ho Chi Minh City, district by district and out to the Mekong, Củ Chi, Tây Ninh and Vũng Tàu corridors.

countries.name: Germany
countries.blurb: Two cross-border regions — Saarbrücken & the SaarLorLux Greater Region, and Aachen & the Dreiländereck (Eifel, Maastricht, Ostbelgien).

countries.name: Belgium
countries.blurb: Four Flemish & Brussels city maps — Antwerp, Ghent, Brussels and Bruges, each with its surrounding area, beer & breweries front and centre. Being built to NYC density.
